_notes: CF CREW D owns days -18, -16, -15, -14. CF D ONE works -16, -15, -14 (07:00-11:00); CF D TWO works only -18. With Last Work Date -14 and Allowed Missing Days 2, TWO misses 3 consecutive crew work days, so the report must print TWO with -Absent- (measured 11-20: a single seeded day printed only the header, since nobody missed more than the allowed days).

Last Work Date is day -14 (<input type=date>), Allowed Missing Days 2; the report's own Date range parameter is left blank. The Time In list is loaded over -18..-14 first: Report stays disabled until it has loaded, and the run takes the list's range as its Date criteria.

Windows alias set measured 2026-11-20: table 'Alias Field | Value | Color'; the rows used are 'Menu: Crew', 'Menu: Employee' and 'Export Identifier'. Alias sets soft-delete and are never purged, so the name is run-minted and its teardown registered before Save.
Layout: allowed line 'Allowed Number of Missing Work Days: N'; the Attendence row prints -Absent- / -No Work- or a dash run.

expected.title: Consecutive Missing Work Days
expected.allowedLine: Allowed Number of Missing Work Days: 2

annotations.description: Matching the layout to Legacy needs the Legacy PDF; the check is the title, the allowed-days line, dated columns, the Attendence row and the alias captions.
